The '''Reinforced AT-1 Tank Torso''', manufactured by [[Nolan (manufacturer)|Nolan]], was a one-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] torso for wheeled/caterpillar [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Although its material durability was only med-high, it could resist to high heat. Such torsos were made of [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]]-[[molybdenum]], [[Steel/Legends|steel]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]] and [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]]. They weighed 60 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and were magnetic.
